customer_message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam

While the sequence is unclear: Only I received the termination form, not my wife; We have both lived here for nine years and cannot find another home quickly; this is what I can confirm.

Regarding “family-home termination with a possible service defect”, my records show: the delivery to spouse remains unresolved; for the request “check form, service, challenge deadline and extension”: some dates are not yet in a reliable order; on “family-home termination with a possible service defect”, I need a concise assessment first; also unresolved: the landlord reason; these points make up my first report.

I am asking for: check form, service, challenge deadline and extension; in particular, I need clarity about the landlord reason and which dates reliably establish the chronology.

I need the chronology checked; It would help to know the delivery to spouse; I can then plan how to proceed.

My first note about it is dated 29 January 2025.

Yours sincerely
